q1.answer_given: User Interface presented multi-function (many possibilities, poor feel) and ease-of-use (fewer possibilities, great feel) remote types, recommending ease-of-use for friendliness and trendiness, though some multi-function elements might still suit the under-40 target. The team settled on a round four-direction push button over a vulnerable stick, doubling as the volume/channel control. UI insisted on keeping the ten digit buttons (wouldn't buy a remote without them) while the Industrial Designer doubted their necessity for a typical Dutch-TV viewer; the choice between keeping the ten digits or adopting voice recognition (which also doubles as a find-the-remote trigger but shortens battery life) was left undecided this meeting.
